name: baseline
notes: Initial baseline with byt5-small, 10 epochs, greedy decoding for eval

name: longer_30ep_beams4
notes: 30 epochs with beam search eval (num_beams=4). Loss plateaued ~epoch 20 then increased (overfitting). Added use_cache, adaptive beams optimizations.

name: byt5_base_30ep
notes: Larger byt5-base model. Training loss continued decreasing through all 30 epochs (2.17 final). Significant improvement in chrF++ (14.46 vs 6.55). Best result so far.

name: byt5_large_regularized
notes: FAILED - Loss plateaued at ~5.6 (never decreased from init). Label smoothing with higher LR may have caused instability. Do NOT merge.

name: sentence_level_data
notes: SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENT! Used sentence-level split data (6220 pairs from 1561 docs). Final loss 0.93 (vs 2.17 baseline). BLEU 4.1x better, chrF++ 1.3x better. Eval took ~70 min due to 4x more val samples.

name: cosine_lr
notes: Cosine LR schedule performed slightly worse than linear. No benefit over baseline. Not worth pursuing.

name: adafactor
notes: SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENT! Adafactor optimizer with lr=1e-4. Final loss 1.49 (vs 2.17 baseline). Very similar results to sentence-level data (12.12). Higher LR works well with Adafactor.

name: larger_batch
notes: Larger effective batch (128 vs 32) with 4x higher LR. Did NOT help - slightly worse than baseline. The competitor's scaling pattern doesn't directly transfer.
